name: KORD BREACH
notes: Seasonal PvP is a separate character from PvP Zone and PvE — progress does not carry over.
The [KORD BREACH] questline is seasonal-only. It starts at Prapor after Tour, with Uninvited Guests.
Battle-pass documents drop in every mode. Daily pickup limits differ: 30 in Season, 20 in PvP Zone, 15 in PvE.

questline.name: Uninvited Guests - Part 1
questline.summary: Find the military equipment case on Shoreline. It sits in one of three places.
spots: Weather station, second floor, by the drawers
Hydroelectric power station, next to the HEP storage key door

questline.name: Uninvited Guests - Part 2
questline.summary: Extract with the case and hand it to the BTR driver. Dying loses it — you will have to pick it up again.

questline.name: Unanswered Calls
questline.summary: In one raid: stash Therapist's message at the TerraGroup office reception (2F), then extract via Nakatani Basement Stairs or Emercom Checkpoint.

questline.name: Cast the Net
questline.summary: Plant WI-FI cameras at six sites across Shoreline, Streets and Ground Zero.
spots: Shoreline — Ural truck by the hydro plant
Shoreline — excavator at the stream near smugglers' base
Streets — concrete mixer at the collapsed crane
Streets — bio toilet near Rodina cinema
Ground Zero — cargo truck cabin near Mira Ave
Ground Zero — yellow bus in the underground tunnel

questline.name: Know Your Enemy
questline.summary: Hand over 5 Black Division plate carriers. They drop off Black Division on Ground Zero (21+), Shoreline and Streets.

questline.name: Reverse Gear
questline.summary: Go back to the cameras from Cast the Net, retrieve each one, and hand them in.

questline.name: Key to Understanding
questline.summary: Find and hand over the Black Division encryption keys.

questline.name: What's in the Bag?
questline.summary: Find and hand over the briefcase with documents.

questline.name: Forbidden Knowledge
questline.summary: Find and hand over the 14-4 KORD SSD.

questline.name: Sheep in Wolf's Clothing
questline.summary: While wearing a Black Division plate carrier, kill 6 Black Division on Shoreline, 6 on Streets, and 6 on Ground Zero.

questline.name: Final Stretch
questline.summary: Grab the laptop from Fence's stash on Streets and hand it over.

questline.name: Consequences of Our Decisions
questline.summary: Decrypt and read the laptop, then hand it to Mechanic. Optional side of Final Stretch.

questline.name: Desperate Assault
questline.summary: Kill 15 Black Division operatives in The Lab. Unlocks after Final Stretch or Consequences.

questline.name: Stay Clear of Blast Zone
questline.summary: Plant TP-200 TNT at the Health Resort west, north and east fence breaches on Shoreline.

questline.name: Break the Chain
questline.summary: Destroy four transmitters: factory chimney and power-line tower on Customs; mountain top and cell tower on Woods.

questline.name: Digital Puzzle
questline.summary: Hand over the data taken from the Black Division rugged laptop.

questline.name: Riding the Wave
questline.summary: Found-in-raid hand-in of Black Division gear (plate carriers, packs, Avon M53A1). Side chain off Reverse Gear.
